name: 高清大框贴合泳镜款
description: 大框清晰视野、软胶镜圈贴合、镜带自由调节的游泳眼镜

styleLock.backgroundSystem: pool-blue #2E8FCF hero walls, fine-textured ice blue #CFE8F7 info panels, clean white #FFFFFF trust surfaces
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, controlled highlights on transparent lens material, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth round display podiums in #FFFFFF and matte smooth board surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines in deep navy #1F3A5C on light panels and #FFFFFF on pool-blue panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single #E56A6A accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale, goggles read as one object across the set; transparent lens renders with controlled highlights, never opaque
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool aquatic sports ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pool blue #2E8FCF, ice blue #CFE8F7, clean white #FFFFFF, deep navy text color #1F3A5C (used for type, not surfaces) and one coral accent #E56A6A; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, controlled highlights on transparent lens material and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines in #1F3A5C on light panels and #FFFFFF on pool-blue panels; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with clean even margins on every screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏用泳池氛围与大框形态一秒抓住点击，顶部落位承接主卖点标题
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward, slight 3/4 view, full product visible on podium, not clipped
shots.lighting: bright soft studio light from the front left with fill, controlled highlights on the lens, soft contact shadows on the podium
shots.background: pool-blue wall #2E8FCF with a calm water surface strip at the bottom
shots.props: a chrome pool ladder and two round display podiums in #FFFFFF
shots.textZone: top third of the pool-blue wall carries headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and a rounded sub-label 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: Product hero banner of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward at a slight 3/4 view, the goggles resting on a round podium in #FFFFFF with a second pair on another podium beside it, a chrome pool ladder prop at the left and a calm water surface strip at the bottom. Bright soft studio light from the front left with fill, controlled highlights on the transparent lens, soft contact shadows on the podium. Background wall surface in #2E8FCF. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with the upper third of the pool-blue wall kept as clean backdrop carrying the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and a rounded sub-label 「{callout_1}」 beneath it. 2K, commercial sports e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logo, no dense body text, no watermark, no model face, no cut-off product edges, no extra props beyond the ladder and podiums.

shots.intent: 一秒说清大框清晰视野的核心利益，左侧清爽版面承载主卖点
shots.camera: front 3/4 eye-level view, product on the right third
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, controlled highlight across the transparent lens, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: left panel copy block: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1F3A5C with a thin #E56A6A underline accent and one thin-line icon
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Front 3/4 eye-level view, the goggles placed on the right of the frame occupying 50-60%, grounded by a soft contact shadow. Soft front-left key light, controlled highlight across the transparent lens. Background of fine-textured surface in #CFE8F7. The left panel carries a short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1F3A5C with a thin underline accent in #E56A6A and one thin-line icon beneath it. Negative: no dense body text, no invented performance numbers, no more than one claim, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大普通泳镜起雾、压眼眶的痛点，右侧落到产品解法
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, straight-on view, identical camera and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel harsh flat light; right panel soft front-left key light
shots.whitespace: clean even margins around both panels with a thin divider between them
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #1F3A5C
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical camera and framing, straight-on view. Left panel: an ordinary small-frame goggle silhouette under harsh flat light with condensation fogging the lens and visible pressure marks around the seal area, conveying blurred uncomfortable swimming. Right panel: {product} with a wide clear transparent lens and a soft seal, lit softly. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background surface in #CFE8F7 on both panels. One short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #1F3A5C. The product occupies 50-60% per panel with clean even margins around both panels. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated test data or statistics, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 水下佩戴场景让买家代入畅游体验，只保留泳者角色不带身份
shots.camera: eye-level underwater side view, swimmer gliding away from camera with no recognizable face
shots.lighting: natural sunlight refracting through water from above, 5500K, soft caustic patterns
shots.background: pool water gradient in #2E8FCF with pool tiles softly out of focus
shots.whitespace: open underwater composition with light rays and clean blue water surrounding the swimmer
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} worn by a swimmer gliding through clear pool water. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at eye level from an underwater side view, the swimmer shown from behind with no recognizable face, the goggle strap and seal clearly visible on the head. Natural sunlight refracting through the water from above, 5500K, soft caustic patterns. Background of pool water gradient in #2E8FCF with pool tiles softly out of focus. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame in an open underwater composition with light rays and clean blue water surrounding the swimmer. Negative: no recognizable face, no distorted hands or limbs, no murky water, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 微距展示软胶镜圈与密封结构，证明贴合不漏水的机制
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high 45-degree angle looking down, shallow depth of field, foreground seam sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing the silicone texture, controlled highlight on the frame edge
shots.whitespace: minimal, the macro detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the soft silicone seal skirt around the lens frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, shallow depth of field with the foreground seam and silicone texture sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the fine silicone texture, controlled highlight on the frame edge. Neutral smooth studio surface in #CFE8F7. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, whitespace minimal as the macro detail is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated product parts, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 特写镜带调节卡扣，讲清长短自由调节的用法

shots.lighting: soft directional light from the front left showing the buckle structure, soft shadow on the surface
shots.background: smooth matte board in #FFFFFF with a subtle shadow gradient
shots.textZone: right panel: short label 「{selling_point_2}」 in #1F3A5C with one thin-line icon in #E56A6A
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of {product} photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, tight zoom on the strap adjustment buckle with the strap looped through it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field, foreground sharp. Soft directional light from the front left showing the buckle structure, soft shadow on the surface. Background of smooth matte board in #FFFFFF with a subtle shadow gradient. The detail occupies 55-60% of the frame anchored left, and the right panel carries a short label 「{selling_point_2}」 in #1F3A5C with one thin-line icon in #E56A6A. Negative: no blurry subject, no tangled strap, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 同机位同光位并排三色，让买家快速选色
shots.camera: directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, three variants arranged in a row with consistent spacing
shots.lighting: even high-key studio light from above, soft contact shadows, identical across all variants
shots.props: small rounded labels under each variant
shots.whitespace: even ice-blue gutters between the three variants
shots.textZone: one small rounded label 「{callout_1}」 under each variant in #1F3A5C
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product} shown in three colorways, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, arranged in a row with consistent spacing. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The three variants are hex-pinned: one in #F5F3EF, one in #4A4FD8 and one in #E56A6A, each with a clear transparent lens, identical hero presentation across all. Even high-key studio light from above, soft contact shadows, no lighting drift between variants. Background surface in #CFE8F7. Each variant carries a small rounded label 「{callout_1}」 in #1F3A5C. The variant row occupies 60-70% of the frame overall with even ice-blue gutters between the three units. Negative: no mixed lighting between variants, no color drift, no texture loss on dark variants, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用贴合密封、清晰视野与可调镜带的可视细节建立信任，不虚构任何认证
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, product on the left, trust panel with thin-line icons on the right
shots.background: white #FFFFFF framed by a light border in #CFE8F7
shots.props: three thin-line icons in #E56A6A on rounded info labels, referencing the soft silicone seal, the clear wide lens and the adjustable strap of {product}
shots.whitespace: clean white margins framing the product and the trust panel
shots.textZone: top headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in #1F3A5C and one short trust label 「{callout_2}」 beside the icon panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The goggles shown straight-on at eye level on the left, occupying 50-60% of the frame. The right side holds a vertical trust panel of three thin-line icons in #E56A6A on rounded info labels, referencing the soft silicone seal, the clear wide lens and the adjustable strap of {product}. Even clean high-key studio light. Background surface in #FFFFFF framed by a light border in #CFE8F7. A short headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in #1F3A5C at the top and one short trust label 「{callout_2}」 beside the icon panel, with clean white margins framing the product and the panel. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no certificate walls or seals, no fake logos, no dense body text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用实色行动按钮与行动文案完成转化
shots.camera: group slight 3/4 view from a slightly low angle, product centered on a podium with a second unit beside it
shots.lighting: slightly punchier soft studio light from the front left, soft contact shadows
shots.props: one round display podium in #FFFFFF and one solid rounded pill button in #FFFFFF
shots.textZone: top CTA headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and a solid rounded button in #FFFFFF carrying pool-blue #2E8FCF CTA text 「{callout_2}」 below the product
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Group slight 3/4 view from a slightly low angle, the goggles centered on a round podium in #FFFFFF with a second unit beside it to suggest a set, the product group occupying 65-75% of the frame. Slightly punchier soft studio light from the front left, soft contact shadows. Background surface in #2E8FCF. A short CTA headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF sits at the top of the pool-blue wall, and one solid rounded button in #FFFFFF with pool-blue #2E8FCF CTA text reading 「{callout_2}」 sits below the product. provenance.notes: 从 8 张大框泳镜爆款详情切片提炼；已剥离源品牌 LOGO 字样、会员二维码、原文案（标题/防雾设计/三色文案/品牌货号信息表），全部替换为 {selling_point}/{callout} 文案槽由投放时填入；认证版式不合成，信任镜改以可核验的产品细节（密封圈、宽镜片、可调镜带）直接呈现，不虚构任何检测或防雾等级；源图无模特，水下场景仅保留泳者角色且不出现可识别面部。
